liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (7 reviews): Reviewer ranks this China Cat into Rider, with its jam between, as the best of 1974; Reviewer's all-time favorite China>Rider; Phil is monstrous, others crisp, and his backing vocals sound old-school [4][5][6][10][11][12][15]
- **Money Money** (1 review): Reviewer finds Donna's singing on Money Money brutal, the show's one drawback [9]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer hears a small St. Stephen tease about three minutes into Greatest Story [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Money Money**: rare: 7 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-17.sbd.miller.89972.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 174 min; rated 4.41/5 by 22 [1]. Said about its sound: This source has more tuning than other circulating sources; a reel flip in China Doll was smoothed with a crossfade [1]
- **gd74-05-17.sbd.gustin.202.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 170 min; rated 3.85/5 by 26 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording crisp; Reviewer says the sound quality matches the gdlive release; Reviewer thinks it is among the crispiest, best sounding Wall of Sound shows of 1974 [4][5][6][10][14]
- **gd74-05-17.partial.aud.28041.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 16 songs; 95 min; rated 3.71/5 by 7 [3]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls endless tuning between songs and oppressive heat inside the P.N.E. Coliseum [7]
- Attendee recalls Commander Cody putting on a better show than the Dead that night [7]
- Reviewer likes the intro of the following month's Providence China>Rider but still prefers this one [5]
- Reviewer says it could be a top-ten show if 1974 weren't so full of other great ones [6]
- Reviewer says it lacks the wilder second-set jams of the best shows that summer [11]
- Reviewer says this segue jam began in spring 1973, with 5/26/73 cited, and lasted through the October 1974 Winterland run [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-17.sbd.miller.89972.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D [1]. Also: Main source: unknown mics to cassette master to cassette to hard drive, shnid 28041; Patches from a cassette-master source cover part of The Promised Land and the end of Playing In The Band [1]
- **gd74-05-17.sbd.gustin.202.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Gustin and Ashley say it may be soundboard cassette master to cassette to DAT to cassette to DAT [2]
- **gd74-05-17.partial.aud.28041.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Mike Kent; transferred by Pantagruel; source: flac16 set 1,2p; hand-held external stereo mic> portable Sony cassette deck> BASF LH C120 MC> [1 cass gen for Promised only] > HD> CDWave > flac frontend >… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Caraway Grateful Dead: [1974-05-17 P.N.E. Coliseum, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1974-05-17-p-n-e-coliseum-vancouver-british-columbia-canada/) [21]
- Fan art by blackmuddyblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Pacific Northwest 1973-1974: The Complete Recordings](https://blackmuddyblog.blogspot.com/2018/09/grateful-dead-pacific-northwest-1973.html) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead P.N.E. Coliseum - May 17, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/may-17-1974) [23]
